comparison.position: 在策略生成前，以入口见证、完整有序列表commit和当前计数绑定用户原始授权文本；agent的摘要工作上下文不参与授权归因。
comparison.tradeoff: RuntimeTickets在副作用前核收件者、对象和预算合同，HMAC审计链不自证前缀完整；本文当前计数拒绝取消省略，却不提供对象validator或安全策略语义。

analysis.title: 认证来源不替代语义授权，副作用合同不替代请求完整性
analysis.body: 两条输入必须分开：摘要服务Agent任务，认证原文服务授权器。occurrence MAC、顺序commit、current count/fresh boundary缺一会留echo/replay/omission缝隙。持久counter测试只在keys/state/issuer可信的前提内成立，SQLite不是Agent隔离。RuntimeTickets则冻结host收紧合同并在effect前审计，callback不确定不重发；它本地的审计链不证明被截短前缀完整。两层可组合但没有本地LLM攻击成功率；完整多模型/live矩阵高成本不复现。

question.question: 该门与RuntimeTickets保护的是同一边界吗？
question.answer: 不是。本文保护策略生成前的原始授权输入；RuntimeTickets在真实副作用前核冻结recipient/object/budget合同。原文完整不证明策略语义正确，合法发送也不证明摘要来源真实。
question.example: 教学例：认证用户原句后生成器仍可能错误放宽recipient，需要下层ticket核具体交付，而不是把MAC当语义理解。

update.summary: 真实HMAC-SHA256 occurrence/sequence分域、精确UTF-8与长度前缀framing、完整有序计数、fresh session/boundary及SQLite持久消费。只释放认证原文，不执行LLM授权语义或真实Agent攻击；可信入口/key/counter隔离是外部前提。1MiB/有符号计数为本地准入，不承诺可用性或生产安全。 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅承接小型CPU认证协议。

comparison.position: Authenticate original user text before policy synthesis using ingress witnesses, an ordered complete commitment and current count. The agent's summary context supplies no authority.
comparison.tradeoff: RuntimeTickets checks recipient/object/budget before effects; its audit HMAC chain does not establish prefix completeness. Current-count checks reject omitted cancellations here but supply neither object validators nor semantic policy safety.

analysis.title: Authenticated origins do not replace semantic authorization or effect contracts
analysis.body: Separate agent summaries from authenticated authorizer input. Occurrence MACs, ordered commitments and current-count/fresh-boundary checks jointly close echo, replay and omission gaps. Persistent-counter tests assume protected keys/state/issuance; SQLite is not agent isolation. RuntimeTickets freezes host-restricting effect contracts, audits before callbacks and avoids retries under uncertainty, but its local chain does not prove complete prefixes. The layers compose without local LLM attack-rate evidence. The full multi-model/live matrix is terminally not reproduced for cost.

question.question: Does this gate protect the same boundary as RuntimeTickets?
question.answer: No. It protects authorization input before policy synthesis; RuntimeTickets checks frozen recipient/object/budget contracts before effects. Intact originals do not prove correct policy semantics or authenticate summaries through valid sends.
question.example: Teaching example: a generator can still broaden recipients after reading authentic text, requiring effect-level ticket checks rather than treating MACs as semantic understanding.

comparison.position: 固定域多agent分类策略在收益未知前分配rho，依赖舍入精确Q后只问所选边际，IPW与KL更新保留实际预算化策略学习。
comparison.tradeoff: OOAS只见aggregate任务回报与逐turn hint，使用共享Exp噪声和整任务同臂概率；本篇可查询反事实坐标。重要性分母、反馈粒度与FTRL/KL更新不可替换。

analysis.title: 预算反馈的无偏性取决于采样事件，不是统一的1/p技巧
analysis.body: SubMAPL的rho是边缘包含概率，固定基数依赖舍入须保E[Z]=rho，query选择不能偷看当前gain或联合action。IPW后在每agent simplex做KL mirror-ascent，sqrt分配最小化二阶矩上界而非保证胜率。OOAS全任务共享noise使同臂事件概率不等于边缘概率乘积，切臂时不归因残差。两者本地都是有限数学核，非LLM Agent。SubMAPL迁移/环境尚未承接且无证据高成本，完整状态保留scope-limited/false full-review，不能制造高成本DONE。

question.question: SubMAPL与OOAS的重要性权重可互换吗？
question.answer: 不可。前者观察被查询的反事实边际，按坐标包含概率校正；OOAS只观察任务总反馈，按共享noise产生的整任务同臂事件概率校正hint残差。两者反馈可见性和更新器都不同。
question.example: 教学例：一任务中切过臂时OOAS残差归因全0；SubMAPL同轮选中的两坐标仍各按自己的rho更新。

update.summary: 固定active-domain的clipped sqrt包含分配、精确Q依赖舍入、独立joint-action采样、仅所选坐标oracle查询、IPW与log-space KL更新；真归一化子模coverage小函数与评估侧期望控制。无LLM Agent、动态迁移M、完整环境/观察策略表，未伪造高成本终态。 组件范围完成；完整便宜模拟/迁移未承接，not_run_scope_limited，非高成本延期。

comparison.position: Before gains are observed, fixed-domain categorical policies allocate rho, round to exactly Q queries, obtain only selected marginals and execute IPW/KL updates.
comparison.tradeoff: OOAS sees aggregate task feedback and turn hints under shared exponential noise/whole-task same-arm events. This paper can query counterfactual coordinates; denominators, feedback granularity and FTRL/KL updates are not interchangeable.

analysis.title: Unbiased budgeted feedback depends on the sampling event, not a generic 1/p trick
analysis.body: SubMAPL rho denotes inclusion marginals: fixed-cardinality dependent rounding must preserve E[Z]=rho, and querying cannot inspect current gains or sampled joint actions. IPW precedes per-agent KL ascent; square-root allocation optimizes a second-moment bound, not success rates. OOAS shared noise makes whole-task same-arm probability differ from products of marginals and assigns no residual after switching. Both local entries are finite mathematical kernels, not LLM agents. SubMAPL migration/environment are unaccepted without high-cost evidence, so full status remains scope-limited with false full review rather than a fabricated cost-DONE terminal.

question.question: Can SubMAPL and OOAS interchange importance weights?
question.answer: No. SubMAPL observes queried counterfactual marginals and corrects coordinate inclusion; OOAS sees task aggregates and corrects hint residuals by a shared-noise whole-task same-arm event. Feedback and updates differ.
question.example: Teaching example: switching arms zeroes OOAS residual attribution, while two queried SubMAPL coordinates still receive their own inclusion-corrected updates.
